setup.title: First-time setup
setup.sub:
You only need to do this once.
After that, it keeps itself up to date from the game logs.
setup.dirHelp:
Finds the folder where Tarkov is installed.
It reads map and quest records from the Logs folder inside.
setup.questHelp:
Does the count match the quest screen in the game? (don't count daily and weekly tasks)
If a trader's count differs, you only need to check that trader.
Click a trader to see which quests are listed.
setup.addHelp:
If you reinstalled the game or the logs were deleted, quests you accepted earlier may be missing.
When you add one, its prerequisite quests are marked as completed automatically.
setup.hideoutHelp:
Look at the hideout screen in the game and click the current level of each station. It saves right away.
You can also change it later in the Hideout tab.

settings.noServer: Couldn't connect to the server. Make sure the program is running.
settings.resetConfirm:
Reset everything?

Hidden quests, hand-over checks, storyline progress, manually added quests, hideout levels and secured items, and your edition will all be deleted. This can't be undone.
settings.resetFailed: Couldn't reset. Make sure the program is running.
settings.title: Settings
settings.dirHelp:
The folder where Tarkov is installed.
Map and quest records are read from the Logs folder inside.
settings.editionHelp:
Your edition decides which hideout stations are already built at the start (also after a prestige).
Stash level, and the Cultist Circle for The Unheard.
settings.runningHelp:
Like Task Manager, it only checks whether EscapeFromTarkov.exe is running, by name.
It never touches game memory or files.
settings.setupHelp:
If you reinstalled the game or the quests don't match the game, open the first-time setup again.
Your selections are kept; only the game folder, quests and hideout levels are checked again.
settings.historyHelp: What changed in each version. Click to expand.
settings.reportTitle: Report a problem · Suggest a feature
settings.reportHelp:
Please leave bugs and ideas in GitHub Issues.
⚠ Don't upload game log files. They contain your login information.
settings.resetHelp:
Hidden quests, hand-over checks, storyline progress, manually added quests, hideout levels and secured items, and your edition are all deleted and you start again from the first-time setup.
Only the game folder is kept. This can't be undone.
settings.langHelp: Language for the interface and game data (quest, item and map names). Changing it reloads the screen.
settings.raidBorderHelp: When 10 minutes are left in the raid, a red glow pulses around the map and gets stronger and faster as time runs out. The first time it turns on, the view switches to the map once.
settings.shotsHelp:
Game screenshots taken for the position marker keep piling up. Only screenshots made by the game are sent to the Recycle Bin; ones you just took are kept.
If you want to keep some, open the folder and move them elsewhere first.
settings.shotsNoFolder: Screenshot folder not found. It is created when you take a screenshot in the game.
settings.shotsConfirm:
Send game screenshots to the Recycle Bin? ({count}, {size})

You can restore them from the Recycle Bin.
settings.shotsPartial: Sent {count} to the Recycle Bin; {left} were left in place. Use [Open folder] to check.
settings.shotsNoRecycle: These cannot go to the Recycle Bin (it is turned off or has no room), so nothing was deleted. Use [Open folder] to clean up yourself.
settings.shotsUnsure: Stopped: could not confirm that {count} reached the Recycle Bin. Please open the Recycle Bin and check.
settings.shotsFailed: Could not clean up. Check that the program is running.

alerts.reportHelp: The codes above are filled in when you report

alerts.translationBody: Quest objectives with no Korean translation or a changed English original (tools/ko_missing.py --all)

LOG-01.title: Can't read the game logs
LOG-01.body: A game update may have changed the log format. Auto map switching, raid time and quest updates may stop.

LOG-02.title: Can't tell which map you're on
LOG-02.body: The raid start shows up, but the map loading line wasn't recognized. A game update may have changed the log format.

LOG-03.title: Can't read the quest records
LOG-03.body: A game update may have changed the quest record format. Quest starts and completions may not show up.

DATA-01.title: Couldn't download new game data
DATA-01.body: Using the saved data for now. It downloads again automatically when the internet is back.

SAVE-01.title: Couldn't read your saved records
SAVE-01.body: A record or settings file is damaged or locked by another program. Saving is paused to protect your records.

SAVE-02.title: Couldn't save your records
SAVE-02.body: This may be caused by folder permissions or a read-only file. Your latest change was not saved.

UPD-01.title: Couldn't check for updates
UPD-01.body: Couldn't reach GitHub. Please check GitHub Releases for a new version yourself.

ERR.title: Unexpected error
ERR.body: Something went wrong that the app couldn't handle. Report it with [Copy report] or report.txt so it can be fixed. Press [Got it] once reported or if it's fine.

report.unclean: The last run didn't close normally (force-closed, froze or PC shut down)
